text.style: font-weight: 900; font-size: 23px; font-family: 'Lato'; text-anchor: start; fill: #1a1a18

g.text: Who pays for what in Africa’s digital sector
African and non-African financiers back connectivity, data storage and AI. Identity, statistics,
registries and e-government fall mostly to states’ own budgets.
Topics receiving more than US$500 million are shown. African and non-African finance: non-state commitments other than aid,
by where the financier is from. Aid: grants, concessional loans and technical assistance. National budgets: states’ own digital lines.
Commitments, not disbursements. 2024 to 2026, as recorded to October 2026.
